title: Potential duality preserves bounded constructibility
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $r\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$. Let $X$ be a Noetherian excellent scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring], equipped with a dimension function $\delta$, and let $K$ be a pinned potential dualizing complex [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Then the functor $D_K=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] sends every $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ to an object of $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. This asserts preservation of bounded constructibility only; invertibility of the biduality morphism is not assumed.
